text: Two-weapon fighting: can wield a light weapon (up to 15 lb) in the off hand instead of a shield, for an extra blow each turn (at -15 to hit).
Trusted by both peoples: 10% better prices in every shop. A keen eye: putting something on reveals one of its unknown runes at once.
Elven archery: +15 to hit with bows (not slings or crossbows).
Stone-thrower: +20 to hit with slings and thrown things. Second breakfast: food lasts half as long again. Small: carries a tenth less.
Tinker: +10 to use magic devices, and recharging a wand or staff backfires half as often.
Delver: digs well with anything, even bare hands (+20 digging without a pick or shovel), and with a pick or shovel gets half as much gold again from a vein. Sturdy: carries a tenth more.
Orc-kin: sleeping orcs are slower to wake to you, and you are never afraid.
Troll rage: once on each level, falling below a quarter of your hit points sends you berserk and heals you a little. Rubble-smasher: clears rubble in one go. Broad back: carries a fifth more.
Foresight: a level's feeling, treasure and all, comes as soon as you arrive; and your life force holds (resist experience drain).
Light of the Eldar: +1 light radius, and undead and demons within your light move more slowly (-2 speed).
Trap-wise: +10 searching and +15 disarming. Venomous: your bare-handed blows poison (1d6 more damage, unless the monster is immune). Small: carries a tenth less.
